description: TU Delft researchers publish the code and data for the arrival-management chapter of their thesis on autonomous air traffic control. The resource contains Python model definitions and training scripts, trained weights and experiment output tables. Training uses procedurally generated traffic with an adapted BlueSky-Gym library. The provider describes evaluation in BlueSky using historical Dutch-airspace scenarios derived from OpenSky data. Coverage: Coverage includes Dutch-airspace evaluation scenarios. The historical traffic period and sampling resolution are not stated in the reviewed description. Access: the public 4TU.ResearchData record describes the release. Licence: GPL-3.0. Cost and current file access are unverified. Caveats: Provider statements about generalisation were not independently tested. This is a research release; operational deployment is not established. Simulation uses include arrival-management model experiments. Related resources are listed in the same native collection; distinct release identities are preserved.
